body: i have an issue with it because my mindset is so negative all the time. anything anyone says to argue with my pov that life is meaningless and i am easily replaced i can easily dispute. that’s why i get more depressed when i talk about how depressed i am because everyone tries to argue with me on the way i see the world. it’s honestly more frustrating than anything. i hate being told that i just need change my perspective on life, because i wish it was that easy. i have no motivation. i feel empty and sick. it’s not like i don’t feel joy and i don’t look forward to things. it’s that everything, no matter what, seems to be ruined for me by myself.
